نستأمي (form X)
# نَسْتَأْمِي (nastaʔmī) /nas.taʔ.miː/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَأْمَى (istaʔmā)
# نَسْتَأْمِيَ (nastaʔmiya) /nas.taʔ.mi.ja/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَأْمَى (istaʔmā)
